knowledge:
- key_parameters: <dataset.name=Character string used to name the results folder and environment image ;; dim.1stLvlSom=Integer defining the square grid size of the primary SOM, or "auto" to use recommended size based on dataset dimensions ;; feature.centralization=Boolean to enable or disable centralization of features (default: TRUE) ;; sample.quantile.normalization=Boolean to enable or disable quantile normalization of samples (default: TRUE) ;; database.dataset=Ensembl dataset name queried via biomaRt (e.g., "hsapiens_gene_ensembl"), or "auto" to automatically detect ;; database.id.type=Type of rowname identifier in the biomaRt database (e.g., "ensembl_gene_id"), obsolete if database.dataset is "auto" ;; group.labels=Vector of group labels for samples, or "auto" for unsupervised grouping ;; group.colors=Vector of colors corresponding to the group labels ;; pairwise.comparison.list=List of group lists defining pairs of sample groups for pairwise comparison ;; activated.modules=List of booleans to toggle specific pipeline steps (reporting, primary.analysis, sample.similarity.analysis, geneset.analysis, psf.analysis, group.analysis, difference.analysis)>
- alternatives: <None mentioned in the documentation>
- when_to_use: <When analyzing large-scale transcriptomics datasets to identify co-expressed gene modules, visualize sample-specific expression portraits, perform functional enrichment, and analyze sample similarity structures in an unsupervised or group-centered manner>
- pitfalls: <Input expression data must be log-transformed before running the pipeline ;; Automatic database detection (database.dataset="auto") may fail, requiring manual definition of database.dataset and database.id.type to enable functional annotations ;; Large datasets with many genes or samples require larger SOM dimensions and can significantly increase runtime (up to several days)>

workflows.name: matrix_input_workflow
workflows.intent: Run the oposSOM analysis pipeline using a standard numerical matrix of expression values.
input: expression_matrix.csv (numerical matrix of log-transformed expression values with genes as rows and samples as columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize environment with opossom.new ;; 2. Assign expression matrix to env$indata ;; 3. Define sample group labels and colors ;; 4. Define pairwise comparison groups ;; 5. Run the pipeline with opossom.run
workflows.code:
library(oposSOM)
env <- opossom.new(list(dataset.name="Tissues",
                        dim.1stLvlSom=20))
data(opossom.tissues)
env$indata <- opossom.tissues
env$group.labels <- c(rep("Homeostasis", 2),
                          "Endocrine",
                          "Digestion",
                          "Exocrine",
                          "Epithelium",
                          "Reproduction",
                          "Muscle",
                      rep("Immune System", 2),
                      rep("Nervous System", 2) )
env$group.colors <- c(rep("gold", 2),
                          "red2",
                          "brown",
                          "purple",
                          "cyan",
                          "pink",
                          "green2",
                      rep("blue2", 2),
                      rep("gray", 2) )
env$preferences$pairwise.comparison.list <-
    list(list(c("liver","kidney cortex"),
              c("accumbens","cerebral cortex")),
         list(c("tongue","small intestine"),
              c("accumbens","cerebral cortex")))
opossom.run(env)

workflows.name: expressionset_input_workflow
workflows.intent: Run the oposSOM analysis pipeline using a Biobase ExpressionSet object containing expression data and phenotype metadata.
input: expression_set.RData (Biobase ExpressionSet object containing assayData and phenoData)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize environment with opossom.new ;; 2. Create ExpressionSet with assayData and phenoData ;; 3. Assign ExpressionSet to env$indata ;; 4. Define pairwise comparison groups ;; 5. Run the pipeline with opossom.run
workflows.code:
library(oposSOM)
env <- opossom.new(list(dataset.name="Tissues",
                        dim.1stLvlSom=20))
data(opossom.tissues)
group.info <- data.frame( 
                  group.labels = c(rep("Homeostasis", 2),
                                       "Endocrine",
                                       "Digestion",
                                       "Exocrine",
                                       "Epithelium",
                                       "Reproduction",
                                       "Muscle",
                                   rep("Immune System", 2),
                                   rep("Nervous System", 2) ),

                  group.colors = c(rep("gold", 2),
                                       "red2",
                                       "brown",
                                       "purple",
                                       "cyan",
                                       "pink",
                                       "green2",
                                   rep("blue2", 2),
                                   rep("gray", 2) ),
													
                  row.names=colnames(opossom.tissues))
library(Biobase)
opossom.tissues.eset = ExpressionSet(assayData=opossom.tissues,
                                     phenoData=AnnotatedDataFrame(group.info) )
env$indata <- opossom.tissues.eset
env$preferences$pairwise.comparison.list <-
    list(list(c("liver","kidney cortex"),
              c("accumbens","cerebral cortex")),
         list(c("tongue","small intestine"),
              c("accumbens","cerebral cortex")))
opossom.run(env)
